raw_text: CRITICAL: Massive DDoS attack underway on NPCI UPI payment gateway infrastructure. Transaction failures being reported across SBI, HDFC, ICICI, and other major banks. Attack traffic estimated at over 3 Tbps from Eastern European IP ranges. RBI cyber crisis management plan likely to be activated. This is unprecedented scale for Indian financial infrastructure.
clean_text: Massive DDoS attack on NPCI UPI gateway causing transaction failures across major banks. Attack traffic over 3 Tbps from Eastern European IPs. RBI crisis plan expected.
